task: Add safe fresh-PASS reuse to ordinary validation so unchanged command execution is not repeated after metadata-only coverage repair.
outcome: After validation commands pass, a later lattice validate on the same clean material and identical validation identity prints PASS with disposition=reused and commandExecutions=0, even when the earlier overall verdict was FAIL solely because verificationEvidence was stale and current coverage has since been repaired. Any command failure or change to code, story files, command plan, effective environment digest, entrypoint, focus/full/profile, required-intent policy, lineage, cleanliness, or HEAD stability prints a refusal reason and executes the real plan.
facts: B-c163 had five successful reruns on identical materialHash and storyFilesHash, wasting 1,926,151ms (32.10 minutes).
B-19ca executed 45/45 commands successfully but persisted overall FAIL solely for stale verificationEvidence, then reran the same 45 commands for 370 seconds after refresh.
Ordinary verifier currently collapses command execution and coverage into one overall result and has no fresh command-PASS reuse gate.
DONE reuse already implements exact-head and trusted-story-metadata-descendant lineage in done-prepare-validation-reuse.ts.
Current TestEvidenceData lacks separate commandExecution status and a complete command/policy/mode/environment identity.
The umbrella convergence remediation plan is not a canonical subsystem contract; routine validate reuse requires its own decision document.
constraints: Any uncertainty or mismatch falls back to execution, never PASS.
Reuse decision runs inside withValidationExecutionLock and rechecks HEAD to prevent TOCTOU.
Reused validation must not rewrite test evidence or create a metadata commit.
Legacy evidence without separate commandExecution PASS and complete identity executes.
Current coverage is recomputed; mutable verificationEvidence records are excluded from command identity, while required intent definitions and workflow policy are identity-bound.
Effective child environment is represented only by a digest, never raw secret-bearing values.
DONE-specific command-spec envelope and build-proof semantics remain DONE-only.
Configured commands, fallback discovery, validate-file and no-validator branches must remain safe.
